color.evidence: desktop_fold/desktop_s01: paper form, deep h2s, mist readonly Product, blue tel/mailto/PDF links, square deep submit. Pagehead is demanded navy wash over yard drums; footer is --deep with mist primary + ghost WhatsApp. Audit: 0/61 contrast fails, 3 bg colors, hue 225, text_color_count 7, no purple. hover_submit #000 wipe waived. .reach still paints six consecutive #0154a7 links, so chromatic accent is not the 10% act-here role; .btn fill is --deep not --action.
strengths: Blue-tinted neutrals (mist #f2f5f8, line #d3dbe3) match DESIGN.md; not default grey or indigo-on-white
Navy bands vs paper split is clear; mist on readonly Product vs white inputs encodes state
Contrast holds (0 fails); CTA hues 218/210 stay inside the navy family

issues.problem: Accent blue is used on every phone, email, PDF and docs link, while the primary submit fills --deep (#012056) instead of --action (#013ea8). Act here is split and the sidebar reads as a blue list.
issues.fix: Keep .btn background as --action (or keep --deep but then set .reach a {color:var(--deep)} and plant tel/WhatsApp to var(--action) so only the two plant numbers carry the chromatic accent). Stack the three emails as separate block links.

issues.problem: Field chrome uses unnamed #5c6b78, outside the 7 named tokens (line is #d3dbe3, muted is #3e4c58).
issues.fix: Replace the input border with var(--muted). Do not introduce a fourth grey.

spacing_rhythm.evidence: Audit: spacing_grid_adherence 100, spacing_distinct 10 (named scale has 8), distinct_radii 1, distinct_shadows 1. desktop_fold: ~80px section padding, ~48px column gap, 16px field stack, 4px label-to-input. .cols.flip is 6fr 5fr (no longer 1fr 1fr) but still reads even. desktop_full/desktop_s02: left column dies after the submit while .reach continues through two 16rem maps, leaving a large paper void. .docs is margin 0 0 16px; .reach h3 is 1.25rem (20px).
strengths: Form proximity ladder is readable: 4px label gap, 16px field gap, 48px column gap, 80px section padding
Your requirement / Contact details share a top edge; 0 radius on buttons, 4px on inputs, no card shadows
Borders only on inputs, maps, header and footer rules

issues.problem: Maps in the 5fr sidebar make .reach much taller than .formcard. desktop_full shows ~200-300px of empty paper under Send quote request. 6fr/5fr still looks like leftover 50/50, so the form is not the dominant column.
issues.fix: On min-width 1024px set .contact .cols.flip {grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(22rem,4fr);gap:var(--s7)}. Move both .place-map blocks out of .reach into a full-width maps row under the two-col grid (Factory map | Office map, gap var(--s5), iframe height 16rem). Sidebar then stops at Factory address.

issues.problem: Inline margin:0 0 var(--s4) wipes .docs {margin-top:var(--s5)}. The TDS/SDS link sits 16px from the quantity row and 16px above Message -- the same rhythm as fields -- so a second action is not a separate group.
issues.fix: Remove the inline margin. Set .formcard .docs {margin:var(--s5) 0} (24px above and below) so it sits between the field grid and Message as its own band.

issues.problem: margin-top:1.25rem (20px) is on a 4px grid but not on the named 4/8/12/16/24 scale; audit reports 10 distinct spacing values vs 8 tokens.
issues.fix: Change .reach h3 to margin-top:var(--s5) (24px). Keep the two phone p's at 0 so intra-group gap stays smaller than the 24px between Phone, WhatsApp, Email.
